description: Source code for Atmel SAM MCU family Quadrature Decoder (QDEC/TC) driver, including device configuration, initialization, and API implementation.

methods.name: qdec_sam_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the current position from the QDEC device.

methods.name: qdec_sam_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current sensor value, specifically rotation position.

methods.name: qdec_sam_start
methods.description: Starts the QDEC by enabling clock and resetting counter.

methods.name: qdec_sam_configure
methods.description: Configures the QDEC device with clock, trigger, and mode settings.

methods.name: qdec_sam_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the QDEC device, connects pins, enables clock, and configures device.
